onboard.label: Onboard pipeline
onboard.confirm_text: This upserts control-table rows for {dataflow_group_id} in {environment_label}.

root.title: Spec root
root.subtitle: Root-level fields of the onboarding JSON/YAML. Every control-table row in this spec is upserted under dataflow_group_id.

fields.label: dataflow_group_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this pipeline group. All control-table rows in this spec are upserted under this ID.

fields.label: spark_config
fields.description: Group-scoped Spark configuration. Keys must start with 'spark.'; values may be string, number or boolean. Pipeline and runtime values strictly override the framework defaults.

fields.label: pipeline_parameters
fields.description: String to value map substituted into ${param} placeholders in transformation_sql, filter_condition and transform_sql. Strings are single-quoted automatically.

root.title: Template variables
root.subtitle: {{catalog}} and {{env}} resolve before parsing, anywhere in the file. ${param} resolves at execution time, only inside transformation_sql, filter_condition and transform_sql — never wrap it in quotes.

observability.title: Observability
observability.subtitle: Telemetry export for the whole spec, configured independently of any flow. Enable it first, then add destinations.

fields.label: observability
fields.description: Master switch. When off, the observability array is omitted from the spec entirely and no telemetry is exported.

observability.title: Destinations
observability.subtitle: Each destination exports telemetry independently. Does not count toward the at-least-one-flow-array requirement.

fields.label: observability[]
fields.description: Array of telemetry export destination configurations.

fields.label: id
fields.description: Unique destination identifier.

fields.label: enabled
fields.description: Master enable switch for this destination. A disabled destination is dropped entirely by the config loader.

fields.label: type
fields.description: Where telemetry is exported.

fields.label: mode
fields.description: triggered extracts event log once after a run; continuous streams every configured event-log table as an always-on process.

fields.label: destination_config.event_log_tables
fields.description: Fully-qualified catalog.schema.event_log_table names streamed together in continuous mode.

fields.label: destination_config.volume_path
fields.description: Unity Catalog Volume directory telemetry files are written to.

fields.label: destination_config.compression
fields.description: Compression applied to exported telemetry files or OTLP requests.

fields.label: destination_config.file_format
fields.description: On-disk format of exported telemetry files.

fields.label: destination_config.endpoint
fields.description: OTLP collector URL. Volume exports need no endpoint — only a Volume path.

fields.label: destination_config.protocol
fields.description: Wire protocol used to talk to the collector.

fields.label: destination_config.resource_attributes
fields.description: OpenTelemetry resource attributes attached to every exported record, e.g. service.name, deployment.environment.

fields.label: auth.type
fields.description: Authentication scheme. Network destinations only — Volume exports authenticate through Unity Catalog.

fields.label: auth.credentials
fields.description: Credential map. Values must be env:<VAR> or secret:<scope>:<key> references — a literal secret is rejected.

fields.label: retry.max_attempts
fields.description: How many times a failed network export is retried. Minimum 1. OTLP_CONSUMER only.

fields.label: retry.backoff_multiplier
fields.description: Exponential backoff multiplier between retries. Must be greater than 1. OTLP_CONSUMER only.

fields.label: timeout_ms
fields.description: Request timeout in milliseconds. Not applicable to Volume exports.

ingestion.title: Flow identity
ingestion.subtitle: Identity and descriptive metadata. Everything but dataflow_id is carried to the control table without validation.

fields.label: dataflow_id
fields.description: Unique ID for this ingestion flow. Referenced by transformation flows.

fields.label: source_system
fields.description: Descriptive metadata — never validated.

fields.label: source_database
fields.description: Descriptive metadata.

fields.label: source_table_name
fields.description: Descriptive metadata.

fields.label: source_description
fields.placeholder: Bronze ingestion from a Volume in the {{env}} environment
fields.description: Becomes target Delta table's COMMENT. Supports {{catalog}} and {{env}}.

ingestion.title: Target dataset
ingestion.subtitle: Where the flow lands in Unity Catalog and what kind of Lakeflow dataset is registered.

fields.label: target_catalog
fields.description: Unity Catalog catalog for the target table.

fields.label: target_schema
fields.description: Schema for the target table.

fields.label: target_table
fields.description: Target Delta table name.

fields.label: target_type
fields.description: streaming_table for incremental, materialized_view for full recompute, batch_table for batch (supporting iceberg), external_sink for table plus export, sink for export only.

ingestion.title: Source type
ingestion.subtitle: Picking a source type decides which source_config fields apply — only those are shown below.

fields.label: source_type
fields.description: autoloader reads files from a Volume, zerobus streams an existing Delta table, asn1 decodes binary CDR files.

fields.label: source_config.path
fields.description: Landing directory Auto Loader monitors for new files.

fields.label: source_config.format
fields.description: File format of incoming data. Maps to cloudFiles.format.

fields.label: source_config.schema_location
fields.description: Where Auto Loader stores inferred schema. If omitted, convention-based default is derived.

ingestion.title: Source · zerobus
ingestion.subtitle: Fields specific to source_type zerobus — a streaming read of an existing Delta table.

fields.label: source_config.source_catalog
fields.description: Catalog of the existing Delta table to stream from.

fields.label: source_config.source_schema
fields.description: Schema of the source table.

fields.label: source_config.source_table
fields.description: Table name of the source.

fields.label: source_config.starting_version
fields.description: Maps to reader option startingVersion.

fields.label: source_config.max_bytes_per_trigger
fields.description: Throttles how much data each micro-batch reads. Maps to maxBytesPerTrigger.

ingestion.title: Source · ASN.1
ingestion.subtitle: Fields specific to source_type asn1. Spark schema is derived from .asn module.

fields.label: source_config.asn1_schema_path
fields.description: ASN.1 module definition file. Must be a real .asn file.

fields.label: source_config.asn1_codec
fields.description: Which ASN.1 encoding to decode.

fields.label: source_config.asn1_pdu_name
fields.description: The top-level SEQUENCE type in .asn file to decode each record as.

fields.label: source_config.capture_technical_metadata
fields.description: Adds __framework_source_file_name/_size/_modification_time/_metadata_headers and gates __framework_ingestion_timestamp_utc.

fields.label: source_config.schema_evolution_mode
fields.description: Maps to cloudFiles.schemaEvolutionMode. rescue sends new or mismatched columns to _rescued_data.

fields.label: source_config.file_pattern
fields.description: Glob or regex filtering which files are picked up. Maps to cloudFiles.fileNamePattern.

fields.label: source_config.normalize_column_names
fields.description: Legacy switch: trim whitespace, lowercase, and replace special characters with underscore.

fields.label: source_config.remove_dups
fields.hint: set the watermark below to bound state
fields.description: Full-row dropDuplicates over every column except __framework_* columns and _rescued_data / _metadata. Without a watermark this holds unbounded dedup state.

fields.label: dedup_watermark.event_time_column
fields.description: Bounds dedup state on a streaming source. A TIMESTAMP column on the ingested DataFrame.

fields.label: dedup_watermark.delay_threshold
fields.description: Spark interval string paired with dedup_watermark.event_time_column.

fields.label: source_config.schema_config_path
fields.description: External JSON/YAML declaring explicit casts, nullability, UC column comments and renames. Resolves directories to latest modified file.

fields.label: source_config.reader_options
fields.description: Passthrough to the Spark reader — one .option(key, value) per entry.

ingestion.title: Source · column normalization
ingestion.subtitle: column_normalization layers over the legacy normalize_column_names boolean.

fields.label: column_normalization.enabled
fields.description: Explicit switch for column normalization. Wins over normalize_column_names when present.

fields.label: column_normalization.case
fields.description: Case applied to normalized column names. lower matches pre-v1.3.0 behaviour; preserve keeps source casing; upper uppercases.

ingestion.title: Source · nested data & standardization
ingestion.subtitle: Flattening applies to nested formats only. data_standardization_sql runs after explode_columns.

fields.label: explode_columns mode
fields.reason: available only for json and parquet formats (and asn1 sources)
fields.hint: the absent / explicitly-empty distinction is load-bearing
fields.description: How explode_columns is written. absent omits key entirely (schema-preserving pass-through). empty writes explode_columns: [] (auto-flattens every nested struct and explodes arrays). named writes listed columns.

fields.label: source_config.explode_columns
fields.description: Only the named top-level columns are processed. A column that is neither struct nor array at runtime is an error.

fields.label: source_config.auto_flatten_all
fields.reason: overridden while explode_columns names specific columns
fields.hint: same effect as the empty explode_columns mode
fields.description: Recursively flattens all nested structs and explodes all arrays regardless of explode_columns. Takes effect while explode_columns is absent or empty.

fields.label: source_config.json_string_columns
fields.reason: available only for json and parquet formats
fields.hint: name, or {column, schema_ddl} for an explicit schema
fields.description: STRING columns holding a JSON document, parsed with from_json / schema_of_json before flattening. Each entry is a column name or {"column": "col", "schema_ddl": "struct<...>"}.

fields.label: source_config.data_standardization_sql
fields.placeholder: trim(region) AS region, upper(country_code) AS country_code
fields.description: Per-column expressions, each ending AS <column>. Restricted grammar: no SELECT/FROM/JOIN/UNION/WHERE/DML/DDL and no semicolons.

ingestion.title: Source · landing retention
ingestion.subtitle: What happens to landing-zone files after ingestion. Maps to cloudFiles.cleanSource.

fields.label: landing_retention_policy.clean_source
fields.description: off leaves files in place, archive moves them, delete removes them.

fields.label: landing_retention_policy.archive_path
fields.hint: missing path degrades archive to off — not a validation error
fields.description: Where archived files are moved. archive with a missing or empty archive_path degrades to off with a runtime warning.

fields.label: landing_retention_policy.retention_days
fields.description: Maps to cloudFiles.cleanSource.retentionDuration as N days. Minimum 0; defaults to 7.

ingestion.title: Source · ZIP handling
ingestion.subtitle: Extracts and optionally PGP-decrypts a ZIP into source_config.path before the reader runs.

fields.label: source_zip_handling.enabled
fields.description: Master switch for in-flight ZIP extraction.

fields.label: source_zip_handling.source_zip_path
fields.description: Directory where ZIP files are found — never a single file.

fields.label: source_zip_handling.zip_file_pattern
fields.description: Which ZIP files to pick up (case-sensitive fnmatchcase).

fields.label: source_zip_handling.target_volume_path
fields.description: Where extracted files are written. Usually matches source_config.path.

fields.label: delete_source_after_extract.action
fields.description: What happens to ZIP after extraction. delete_now deletes immediately; delete_after_x_days runs age-based sweep.

fields.label: delete_source_after_extract.days
fields.description: Age in days after which a successfully-extracted archive is swept.

fields.label: pre_extraction_decryption.type
fields.description: Outer decryption layer applied before extraction. Only pgp is supported.
Unity Catalog secret catalog holding the key.

fields.hint: iceberg: batch_table only · Iceberg reads elsewhere via UniForm table property
fields.description: Target table format. iceberg is only valid when target_type is batch_table — for every other target type, leave this on delta and add table property enable_iceberg_read_uniformity: true instead.

fields.label: target_config.capture_technical_metadata
fields.description: Transformation flows only. Gates __framework_ingestion_timestamp_utc.

fields.label: partition_columns mode
fields.hint: [] means explicitly unpartitioned, never an error
fields.description: absent omits partition_columns entirely. unpartitioned writes partition_columns: [] — an explicit declaration that table is not partitioned. named writes columns you list.

fields.label: target_config.partition_columns
fields.description: Physical partitioning. Only effective for APPEND and TRUNCATE_AND_LOAD — silently ignored for CDC-dispatched strategies.

fields.label: target_config.liquid_clustering_columns
fields.description: Liquid clustering keys. Only effective for APPEND and TRUNCATE_AND_LOAD. Maximum of 3 columns.

fields.label: target_config.table_properties
fields.description: Delta table properties, added as key-value pairs. Documented keys: log_retention_duration, deleted_file_retention_duration, enable_iceberg_read_uniformity.

fields.description: Row age reference column (DATE/TIMESTAMP/TIMESTAMP_NTZ). Only valid for APPEND and TRUNCATE_AND_LOAD.

fields.label: auto_ttl.expire_in_days
